findings.decompiled: mem[_25 + ceil32(_2) + 192 len 1] = byte(tokenId % 10, 0x3031...) / s = _25 + ceil32(_2) + 193 / t = tokenId / while t / 10: mem[s - 2 len 1] = byte(t / 10 % 10, 0x3031...) / s = s - 1 / t = t / 10
findings.source: Strings.toString: while (true) { ptr--; assembly { mstore8(ptr, byte(mod(value, 10), HEX_DIGITS)) } value /= 10; if (value == 0) break; }
findings.issue: The do-while digit loop is rotated (P3): the first digit is written before the loop and each iteration writes the digit of the next quotient, so the loop test and the written digit are both on t / 10 and the write address is s - 2.
findings.rule: Recognise the do-while shape 'body; v = v / 10; if v != 0: repeat' as one loop with its body at the top (see c00159's rule); do not peel the first iteration.
